# nuplan-devkit and what its import chain needs, installed with --no-deps.
#
# navsim/common/dataclasses.py imports nuplan's map and database modules at
# module level, which drag in a geospatial and an S3 stack that inference never
# calls.  Each line below is a module the chain was seen to import (found by
# importing navsim.agents.recogdrive.recogdrive_agent until nothing was
# missing), pinned to the version tested.  --no-deps because the declared
# dependencies cannot be resolved on aarch64: geopandas 0.14 requires fiona,
# which has no aarch64 wheel and is never imported, and nuplan-devkit's own
# requirements are its full simulation environment.
nuplan-devkit @ git+https://github.com/motional/nuplan-devkit/@nuplan-devkit-v1.2
